name.\n111\t\n112\t`@DocumentId` annotation marks a field to be used as document id.\n113\tThis annotation is required and the annotated field can only be of `String` type.\n114\t\n115\tNOTE: If the this.firestoreOperatons.deleteAll(User.class);\n191\t\t}\n192\t}\n193\t----\n194\t\n195\tThe Template API provides support for:\n196\t\n197\t- Read and write operations\n198\t- <<Transactions>>\n199\t- <<Subcollections>> operations\n200\t\n201\t\n202\t=== Query methods by convention\n203\t\n204\t[source, java]\n205\t----\n206\tpublic class MyApplication
